subject: Autumn Newsletter: Sponsor credit allocation for October cohort
messages:
From: Lina Suarez <lina.suarez@edgetech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partner_ops@edgetech.com
Date: 2025-10-05T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsorship: newsletter cohort promo credits request

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the run-through last week — EdgeTech's audience responded well to Redwood during the pre-show. We have a 10/20 autumn newsletter going to our developer cohort (approx. 3,000 recipients, segmented into a small trial pool of ~200).

We'd like to offer a Redwood trial credit to the cohort as part of the sponsor package. Specifically, can Redwood issue 200 single-use promo codes that grant a 90-day trial with $25 of credit each (redeemable on hosted API)? Budgeted total would be $5,000.

Attach: Sponsorship_Summary_EdgeTech_Q4.pdf

Questions we have:
- Is single-use promo code generation supported?
- Can you set an expiry of 12/31/2025 or 90 days from redemption (whichever is earlier)?
- Any terms we should surface in the newsletter copy?

If this is doable, please advise next steps and any approvals you need on your end.

Best,
Lina Suarez
Events & Partnerships | EdgeTech Inc.
Lina.Suarez@edgetech.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Suarez <lina.suarez@edgetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship: newsletter cohort promo credits request

Hi Lina — thanks for the clear ask and the brief. Looping in Marissa (sales) and Vanessa (partnerships ops) to confirm feasibility.

Quick answers up front:
- We can generate single-use promo codes and provide a CSV for you to drop into your mail platform.
- We can set expiry to 12/31/2025 or to a duration from first redemption; we'll default to 90 days from redemption if you don't require the hard calendar date.
- Terms: promo codes are for new Redwood accounts only, not combinable with other offers; we'll provide a short blurb to paste into the newsletter.

Marissa/Vanessa — can you propose a promo code naming convention, TTL, and confirm whether finance needs a PO or special accounting code for the $5k spend? We should also link this to the HubSpot sponsorship deal (HS-78934).

Thanks,
Sean
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lina Suarez <lina.suarez@edgetech.com>
Date: 2025-10-06T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship: newsletter cohort promo credits request

Thanks, Sean. Hi Lina — happy to own this. Proposed allocation: 200 single-use codes, $25 credit each, 90-day redemption TTL (we'll put an absolute expiry 12/31/2025 as a backstop). Promo code format: REDWOOD-EDGETECH-25-XXXX (XXXX = 4 char unique suffix).

Operational notes:
- I will create the codes in our internal promo service and export a CSV with code, expiration, and redemption URL.
- We'll include a short blurb for the newsletter: "Redeem a $25 Redwood credit for new accounts — valid for 90 days after first use. Terms apply."
- For tracking, please confirm the HubSpot deal ID (HS-78934) so we can tag redemptions to the campaign.

Evelyn — finance: do you need a PO or internal charge code for this $5k promotional allowance? If a PO is required, can we process a one-off marketing promo spend?

Lina: if that all looks good, I can create the codes by 10/12 and send the CSV to you with simple install instructions.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-07T14:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship: newsletter cohort promo credits request

Hi team — finance ok to treat this as a marketing promotion expense (GL: MKT-PROMO-2025). No formal PO required for a one-off under $10k; please tag the HubSpot deal (HS-78934) so accounting can reconcile redemptions against the allowance.

Two requests before we publish codes:
1) Add a line in the internal notes with the expected campaign start date (10/20/2025).
2) Include an expiry date in the CSV export for audit purposes (we'll accept the 12/31/2025 backstop).

Once Marissa confirms the CSV and notes, finance is good to move forward.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-09T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship: newsletter cohort promo credits request

Perfect — Marissa, please produce the codes and attach the CSV to the HubSpot deal. Vanessa, please add the campaign start date to the internal promo notes and confirm the expiry column is present in the CSV (format: YYYY-MM-DD). Also add the accounting code (MKT-PROMO-2025) to the notes so Finance can pick it up.

Marissa: if you can do this by end of day 10/12, I'll send the confirmation back to EdgeTech with the codes.

Thanks all.
Sean

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Suarez <lina.suarez@edgetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-12T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsorship: newsletter cohort promo credits request

Lina — all set. Attached is the promo_codes_autumn_20251012.csv with 200 single-use codes (format: code,expiry,redemption_url). Expiry column is set to 2025-12-31 for all codes; redemption TTL is 90 days from first use. We've also tagged the HubSpot deal (HS-78934) and added internal notes with campaign start 2025-10-20 and GL code MKT-PROMO-2025 for reconciliation.

Attach: promo_codes_autumn_20251012.csv

Copy you can paste into the newsletter: 
"Redeem a $25 Redwood credit for new accounts. Codes valid for 90 days after first use; expires 12/31/2025. New accounts only; not combinable with other offers. For full terms see: https://www.redwoodinference.com/terms/promo"

Please confirm receipt and whether you want the codes delivered as a downloadable file in the newsletter or as unique links for each recipient. Happy to accommodate either.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
